user_story: As a user, I want logging out twice in a row to not cause an error so that the logout action is idempotent.

positive.title: User successfully logs out twice in a row without an error.
steps: User is logged into the application.
User clicks on the logout button.
User clicks the logout button again.
User observes message indicating they are already logged out.
positive.expected_result: User is logged out and receives confirmation each time without any errors.

negative.title: Attempt to logout when network is disconnected.
steps: User is logged into the application.
User clicks on the logout button.
negative.expected_result: User is notified of network error and remains logged in.

edge.title: Simultaneously trigger multiple logout requests.
steps: User is logged into the application.
User opens multiple tabs of the same session.
User clicks the logout button in all tabs simultaneously.
edge.expected_result: Application handles multiple requests gracefully; user is logged out without error messages.
